fresh_isolation.rule: No fresh task may be instantiated by training or development code before a checkpoint digest is frozen in a separate pre-fresh lock.

architecture.recurrent: GRUCell over public observation plus public action-memory tokens
architecture.public_conditioning: explicit state parity plus regime-parity action memory; visible targets also expose normalized modular forward-distance features

goal_belief.supervision_scope: train-only implicit_goal_regimes hidden goal label; visible-target families contribute zero auxiliary goal loss
goal_belief.inference: recurrent hidden -> 3x5 neural goal logits -> soft expected goal embedding; embedding is gated into the policy only when public target_visible=0
goal_belief.representation: full 15-way categorical belief (3 coordinates x 5 values) projected to policy hidden state; no scalar expectation compression
goal_belief.supervision_start: only after every non-submit action has at least one public transition in the current context
